items.prompt: Customers were asked to return the faulty devices, and most ___ within a week.

explanation.en: Did so replaces the verb phrase returned the devices.

optionNotes.en: So did would mean also did, which does not fit.
Did it so is not a possible form.

items.prompt: 'Is the library open late on Fridays?' 'I think ___, but check the website.'

explanation.en: After think, use so to replace the whole clause.
explanation.es: «Creo que sí» = I think so, no I think yes.

optionNotes.en: It cannot replace a whole clause after think.
Yes is not used after think in English.

items.prompt: She did not join the excursion, although she had been invited ___.

explanation.en: The infinitive is shortened to to after invited.

optionNotes.en: For does not stand for the infinitive.
It cannot replace the infinitive here.

items.prompt: The first draft was too long, so I wrote a shorter ___ for the newsletter.

explanation.en: One replaces a singular countable noun (draft).
explanation.es: En inglés hace falta one: no se dice «a shorter».

optionNotes.en: Ones is plural, but a shorter ___ is singular.
It cannot take an adjective like shorter.

items.prompt: Not all employees support the new policy, but several ___.

explanation.en: The auxiliary of the first clause (do support) is repeated alone.

optionNotes.en: Have does not match the verb support.
Are does not match the verb support.
